headline: European Commission publishes an AI Act harmonized-standards decision for high-risk systems
summary: The European Commission lists Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/2274 as adopted on 12 October and published in the Official Journal on 14 October 2026. A Commission explanation published 19 October identifies EN 18286:2026 as the first harmonised standard supporting the AI Act and says providers implementing it receive a presumption of conformity for the Article 17 requirements it covers. The Spanish-language Official Journal text confirms the annex lists EN 18286:2026 and says the Commission with CEN/CENELEC assessed it against the request; the decision describes quality-management systems including post-market controls. The full standard clauses, provider adoption and compliance outcomes remain unknown.
